1.helpText:
When this is played, if there are any enemies in play, cross out 1 production. Note that it doesn't matter how many enemies are in play, only cross out 1 production when this is played.

However, once this is in play, you must cross out 1 production each time an enemy is played. If 2 enemies are played at the same time (in an advance action, for instance), you must cross out 2 production! So be careful!

description: This is a card from the Ridding the Woods expansion.
